G1-B produces authentic local spawn/pid/exit observations on its healthy path, but its Correlator still exposes caller-controlled trust admission surfaces and does not enforce every claimed Run/Claim/Readback relationship for all inputs. T0 therefore classifies it conservatively

unsupportedRelationshipsIdentifiedBefore: No read API for a ProjectIR revision BY NUMBER (historical revisions require event replay).
No first-class read of the rework provenance BODY (only the TASK_READY event id).
No per-attempt promotion-record read (reconstruct via promotionIdFor + readPromotionFacts).
No projectId / project association inside the Reasoning Cell and Proof Asset planes (the association is owned by Project Workspace).
No accepted Intent Receipt store or read-by-id (scan PROJECT_REVISED payloads).
No associated(kind, id) membership check on Project Workspace.
No candidate read API in either the Reasoning or Proof plane.

duplicateStoreDecision.reason: T0 owns only the INTERPRETATION and PRESENTATION of references. Every absent read capability above is satisfied by reading the owning store directly through a structural port (event-log replay, store.replay/basis) rather than by creating a second canonical store.
